description: Get JPEG thumbnails for 1–20 photos in input order for culling. Each preview names its photo_id and 1-based image_index, with width, height, bytes and scaled_by_server as in get_photo_preview; a photo that cannot be rendered is failed, the others still arrive; a photo Lightroom answers it has no preview pixels for is asked again within the time, which can leave the photos after it remaining. Total budget 8 MiB. Photos not reached by 20 s or beyond the budget are remaining; resend them. The photo open in Develop gets no thumbnail, since Lightroom's thumbnail there can be stale or an enlarged low-resolution copy: it fails at once, naming render_photo; for that photo take one look before editing and one after, not one per step. Lightroom's preview cache can answer with an enlargement of a smaller cached preview, most often on a cropped photo, without saying so; judge fine sharpness with get_photo_detail. Catalog unchanged.

photo_ids.description: Between 1 and 20 IDs or paths, in image order

size.description: Longest edge returned: cull (864) or review (1728) as in get_photo_preview, or a number 64-2048; default 256. A larger Lightroom image is scaled down to it, at most 2000px

name: get_photo_previews
title: Get batch photo previews
